proposals.before: During Taiping, as a maternal kinsman he was appointed attendant gentleman and served as Xianchang Palace commissioner and deputy front-hall inspector.
proposals.after: During Taiping, as a maternal kinsman he was appointed attendant gentleman and served as Yanchang Palace commissioner and deputy front-hall inspector.
proposals.reason: 延昌 is Yanchang, not Xianchang; 咸 would be Xian.

decisions.reason: Source 延昌宮使 uses 延 (yán), not 咸 (xián); Xianchang is a wrong reading, and Yanchang Palace commissioner correctly renders the office while leaving the rest of the idiomatic sentence intact.
The literal field has the same misreading of 延昌 as Xianchang; Yanchang matches 延昌 and corrects the palace-office name without other changes.
